summary: The proof correctly derives the clipped minimum and its endpoint values, identifies the exact directional halfspace infimum, establishes continuity and monotonicity of the superlevel function, and converts the depth condition into the stated planar intersection criterion. The Radon and compactness argument correctly extends the three-set Helly criterion to the full directional family. Boundary cases and the conditional applicability at t=2T/9 are handled by the horizontal inequalities.
